Named Inflows (signature; form): faction_tax (self; inflow, rate modified by hex.wealth); faction_rally (self; conversion from NPC.ideo_x)
Named Outflows (signature; form): faction_radicalize (self; conversion to ideology bucket); engine_decay
Notes: Lifecycle anchor — faction dissolves at 0. tax accrues cohesion at a rate modified by hex.wealth (hex not consumed). rally is plane→polar: depletes aligned NPC.Ideo·X to raise cohesion. radicalize is polar→plane: depletes cohesion, raises dominant ideology bucket.
Recruit gates on settlement.residents without depleting them (dual allegiance). Maintain spends support on custodian artifact upkeep.

Named Outflows (signature; form): faction_attract (self; conversion to NPC.ambition); faction_patrol (self; conversion to settlement.security); engine_decay
Notes: Gated by custodian artifact power (non-depleting — artifact keeps its power while projecting influence). Spent on attracting NPCs and patrolling settlements.

Named Outflows (signature; form): faction_consecrate (self; shifts Ideo·X UP → Individualist; plane-plane mutual with Region.Res·X); faction_indoctrinate (self/target; drift ↔ NPC/settlement)
Rate Modulators (flow -> direction; form: faction_radicalize (self; shifts Ideo·X DOWN → Collectivist; polar→plane, depletes cohesion); faction_indoctrinate (self/target; drift ↔ NPC/settlement)
column13: Plane rows: 'Inflow'/'Outflow' = axis shift UP/DOWN. consecrate shifts faction Ideo·X UP (toward Individualist) while also shifting Region.Res·X UP (toward Resonant) — mutual UP on both sides. radicalize shifts Ideo·X DOWN (toward Collectivist), depleting cohesion. Indoctrinate drifts depend on partner state.
